note: ruling 3: series 3 read (air and relief are not the cause at the top left), the plate chains looked at; nothing built yet

looks.label: STUDY the mid plate's chain: guide, take, plate with the near plate nested, wedge. Outside the nest ring nothing of the view is in it
STUDY the near plate's chain: guide (the core image laid back), take, plate, wedge. FAULT outside the wedge the take invented its own ground
STUDY the fore plate's chain: guide, take, plate, wedge of the image. FAULT the ring of white cumulus round the storm is the take's invention, not the view's
STUDY the wide canvas laid back on the mid plate from above; rings at 8, 11, 15, 20, 24 units from the point under the fit eye: clear inside 8, petal blobs to 11, smeared to 15, haze colours beyond
STUDY the same with the plates alone on a flat relief: 0.49 0.48 0.48; so the relief is not the cause there
STUDY rise rows 3251 to 3253 with the plates alone and no air: 0.46 0.45 0.52, the most at the top left horizon; so the air is not the cause there
rise 3247, 3251, 3255, 3259 on the named bytes: dusk and dark aprons give way to the pale ring and the day
the wide canvas (left) and the plates through the air tables from the fit camera (right, plates at low size); yellow the approved frame
rise 3255 and 3259: top the named bytes, bottom the rim off (the canvas dusk fan ends in a straight line)
rise 3251 to 3255 with the rim off: 0.96 to 1.26, the canvas edge shows at the right limb
rise 3261 + 1/2: top a rigid sequence (one picture carried by the sphere), bottom the film; the measure reads 0.70 and 0.69

FAULT the ground of the fore plate: left the approved view laid back (yellow the approved frame, red the wide canvas), right the plate as shipped; between yellow and red they are two pictures of one ground
STUDY plates alone, 3253 against 3261 carried back: over 0.45 (red outline) only at the top left under the bright air and in the lower left corner
STUDY rise rows 3251 to 3255 with the approved view never given up: 0.50 0.50 0.49 0.45 0.45; the most is at the right far field and the lower left corner
STUDY rise rows 3251 to 3255 with the plates alone (no approved view drawn): the pattern port reads 0.45 0.46 0.52 0.49 0.45, limit 0.45; frame, frame 8 later carried back, pattern map
study near plate from above: nest rings yellow, the core's fan green, the wide canvas' fan magenta
REJECTED far field candidate b from above, left the bare mid plate, right with the view's band: washed
FAULT rise 3251.5 against 3259.5 carried by the ground, top left: the view's cream rows, then the plate's brown belt
FAULT rise 3251.5 against 3259.5 carried by the ground, right far field: the view's dusk, then the plate's white zone in day
FAULT, first candidate of the far field made from the view (left the mid plate today, right the candidate, top down, 20 units wide): a fan of radial streaks with colour fringes. Not kept
Plates alone, pairs 3247, 3251, 3255 against 8 frames later carried by the ground: 0.58, 0.51, 0.49 by my strict reading (the named bytes 0.73, 0.72, 0.79). Red outlines are over 0.45

same pair, bottom left near the eye: dark cumulus of the wide canvas at 3251 + 1/2, the plate's smooth bank at 3259 + 1/2. FAULT, the cream bank
